segments.source: Known Issues
segments.normalizedSource: Known Issues
segments.contextBefore: Memory Allocation
segments.contextAfter: The system memory allocator `free` operation zeroes out most deallocated blocks in watchOS 9.1 beta or later. Invalid accesses to free memory might result in new crashes or corruption, including: - Read-after-free bugs that previously observed the old contents of a block may now observe zeroes instead

segments.source: The system memory allocator `free` operation zeroes out most deallocated blocks in watchOS 9.1 beta or later.
